name: Baguio City Open 2023

venue.name: Barangay Phil-Am Basketball Court
venue.details: Phil-Am Basketball Court is situated nearby to the police station Balsigan Tanod Outpost and Baguio General Hospital.

information: This is the comeback of the WCA Annual competition in Baguio City, the summer capital of the Philippines. Base registration fee is 300php, good for 3 events. Additional events registered shall entail 50php additional registration fee each.
